items.question: Trong câu "Cramming everything into one picture is the fastest way to produce something nobody can read.", từ "cram" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Cramming everything into one picture is the fastest way to produce something nobody can read.", what does "cram" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to study hard just before an exam
to force too much into a space
items.explanation: cram /kræm/ (động từ): nhồi nhét. "Cram X into Y" = nhồi X vào Y; nghĩa khác: "cram for an exam" = học nhồi.
items.explanationEn: cram /kræm/ (verb): to force too much into a space. "Cram X into Y" means to squeeze X into Y; "cram for an exam" means last-minute study.

items.question: Trong câu "Classic process modeling uses four diagrams at four levels of zoom.", từ "zoom" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Classic process modeling uses four diagrams at four levels of zoom.", what does "zoom" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the degree of close-up or distance
items.explanation: zoom /zuːm/ (danh từ): mức độ phóng to/thu nhỏ. "Zoom in" = đi vào chi tiết; "zoom out" = nhìn tổng quan.
items.explanationEn: zoom /zuːm/ (noun): the degree of close-up or distance. "Zoom in" means focus on detail; "zoom out" means see the big picture.

items.question: Trong câu "Work outside in: settle the boundary, then the departments, then the sequence, then the detail.", từ "settle" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Work outside in: settle the boundary, then the departments, then the sequence, then the detail.", what does "settle" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: settle /ˈset.əl/ (động từ): chốt, quyết định dứt điểm. "Settle an issue/scope" = giải quyết dứt điểm vấn đề/phạm vi; "settle a bill" = thanh toán.
items.explanationEn: settle /ˈset.əl/ (verb): to decide something finally. "Settle an issue/scope" means to resolve it; "settle a bill" means to pay it.

items.question: Trong câu "Work outside in: settle the boundary, then the departments, then the sequence, then the detail.", từ "sequence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Work outside in: settle the boundary, then the departments, then the sequence, then the detail.", what does "sequence" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the order in which things happen
items.explanation: sequence /ˈsiː.kwəns/ (danh từ): trình tự. "In sequence" = theo thứ tự; "sequence diagram" = sơ đồ tuần tự.
items.explanationEn: sequence /ˈsiː.kwəns/ (noun): the order in which things happen. "In sequence" means in order; a "sequence diagram" shows interactions over time.

items.question: Trong câu "Working the other way — starting with a detailed flowchart — is the most common way to discover in week six that you left out an entire participant.", từ "leave out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Working the other way — starting with a detailed flowchart — is the most common way to discover in week six that you left out an entire participant.", what does "leave out" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: leave out /ˌliːv ˈaʊt/ (cụm từ): bỏ sót, không đưa vào. "Leave X out (of Y)" = bỏ X ra khỏi Y; từ đồng nghĩa trang trọng: omit.
items.explanationEn: leave out /ˌliːv ˈaʊt/ (phrase): to fail to include. "Leave X out (of Y)" means not include X; a formal synonym is "omit".

items.question: Trong câu "Why a BA needs all four: each zoom level exposes a different kind of missed requirement.", từ "expose" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Why a BA needs all four: each zoom level exposes a different kind of missed requirement.", what does "expose" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: expose /ɪkˈspəʊz/ (động từ): làm lộ ra. "Expose a problem/gap" = làm lộ ra vấn đề; trong API "expose an endpoint" = mở ra cho bên ngoài dùng.
items.explanationEn: expose /ɪkˈspəʊz/ (verb): to reveal something hidden. "Expose a problem" means to reveal it; "expose an endpoint" means to make it available.

items.question: Trong câu "The context model exposes forgotten integrations.", từ "integration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The context model exposes forgotten integrations.", what does "integration" (noun) mean?
options: kết nối tích hợp hệ thống
items.explanation: integration /ˌɪn.tɪˈɡreɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): kết nối tích hợp hệ thống. Động từ: integrate; "integration with the bank" = kết nối với hệ thống ngân hàng.
items.explanationEn: integration /ˌɪn.tɪˈɡreɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a connection between systems. Verb: integrate; "integration with the bank" means a link to its system.

items.question: Trong câu "The cross-functional flow exposes handoffs that cause delay.", từ "handoff" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The cross-functional flow exposes handoffs that cause delay.", what does "handoff" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: handoff /ˈhænd.ɒf/ (danh từ): sự chuyển giao công việc. Còn viết "hand-off"; động từ: "hand off" = chuyển giao cho người khác.
items.explanationEn: handoff /ˈhænd.ɒf/ (noun): passing work to another person. Also written "hand-off"; the verb is "hand off".

items.question: Trong câu "The flowchart exposes decision branches that were never covered.", từ "branch" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The flowchart exposes decision branches that were never covered.", what does "branch" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: one possible path from a decision
items.explanation: branch /brɑːntʃ/ (danh từ): nhánh rẽ (luồng). "Decision branch" = nhánh quyết định; nghĩa khác: "bank branch" = chi nhánh ngân hàng.
items.explanationEn: branch /brɑːntʃ/ (noun): one possible path from a decision. "Decision branch" is one path from a choice; "bank branch" is a local office.

items.question: Trong câu "A context model puts the organization (or system) in the middle and every external party around it.", từ "external" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A context model puts the organization (or system) in the middle and every external party around it.", what does "external" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: external /ɪkˈstɜː.nəl/ (tính từ): bên ngoài. Trái nghĩa: internal; "external party" = bên ngoài tổ chức (khách hàng, ngân hàng…).
items.explanationEn: external /ɪkˈstɜː.nəl/ (adjective): coming from outside. Opposite: internal; an "external party" is outside the organization.

items.question: Trong câu "Each arrow is a flow — data, documents, goods, or money — labeled with what it actually is.", từ "label" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each arrow is a flow — data, documents, goods, or money — labeled with what it actually is.", what does "label" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to attach a name or description
items.explanation: label /ˈleɪ.bəl/ (động từ): ghi nhãn, chú thích. Trong sơ đồ mọi mũi tên nên được "labeled" (ghi rõ nội dung dòng chảy).
items.explanationEn: label /ˈleɪ.bəl/ (verb): to attach a name or description. In diagrams every arrow should be "labeled" with what flows.

items.question: Trong câu "Each arrow is a flow — data, documents, goods, or money — labeled with what it actually is.", từ "goods" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each arrow is a flow — data, documents, goods, or money — labeled with what it actually is.", what does "goods" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: products that are bought and sold
items.explanation: goods /ɡʊdz/ (danh từ): hàng hóa. Luôn ở dạng số nhiều; "goods and services" = hàng hóa và dịch vụ.
items.explanationEn: goods /ɡʊdz/ (noun): products that are bought and sold. Always plural; "goods and services" is a common pairing.

items.question: Trong câu "It deliberately says nothing about what happens inside the organization.", từ "deliberately" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It deliberately says nothing about what happens inside the organization.", what does "deliberately" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: deliberately /dɪˈlɪb.ər.ət.li/ (trạng từ): một cách cố ý. Tính từ: deliberate; nghĩa là có chủ đích chứ không phải thiếu sót.
items.explanationEn: deliberately /dɪˈlɪb.ər.ət.li/ (adverb): on purpose. Adjective: deliberate; it means intended, not an oversight.

items.question: Trong câu "That is its strength, not a gap.", từ "strength" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That is its strength, not a gap.", what does "strength" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: strength /streŋθ/ (danh từ): điểm mạnh. "Strengths and weaknesses" = điểm mạnh và điểm yếu (như trong SWOT).
items.explanationEn: strength /streŋθ/ (noun): a good or useful quality. "Strengths and weaknesses" appear together, as in SWOT.

items.question: Trong câu "It reads more clearly as a table — and the table is what belongs in your document, because it survives being printed in black and white:", từ "survive" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It reads more clearly as a table — and the table is what belongs in your document, because it survives being printed in black and white:", what does "survive" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to stay alive after an accident
items.explanation: survive /səˈvaɪv/ (động từ): vẫn dùng tốt khi qua. Ở đây nghĩa bóng: bảng vẫn đọc được khi in đen trắng; nghĩa gốc là "sống sót".
items.explanationEn: survive /səˈvaɪv/ (verb): to still work after something. Figurative here: the table still works in black and white; literally "stay alive".

items.question: Trong câu "A context model settles three things projects usually argue about later:", từ "argue" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A context model settles three things projects usually argue about later:", what does "argue" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: argue /ˈɑːɡ.juː/ (động từ): tranh cãi. "Argue about X" = tranh cãi về X; "argue that…" = lập luận rằng.
items.explanationEn: argue /ˈɑːɡ.juː/ (verb): to disagree in words. "Argue about X" means dispute X; "argue that…" means to claim with reasons.

items.question: Trong câu "Scope — what is inside the circle is ours; what is outside belongs to someone else.", từ "scope" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Scope — what is inside the circle is ours; what is outside belongs to someone else.", what does "scope" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: scope /skəʊp/ (danh từ): phạm vi. "In scope / out of scope" = trong/ngoài phạm vi; "scope creep" = phạm vi phình ra dần.
items.explanationEn: scope /skəʊp/ (noun): the range a project covers. "In scope / out of scope"; "scope creep" is uncontrolled growth of scope.

items.question: Trong câu "The stakeholder list — every external box is a group that has to be consulted.", từ "consult" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The stakeholder list — every external box is a group that has to be consulted.", what does "consult" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to look up in a book
items.explanation: consult /kənˈsʌlt/ (động từ): hỏi ý kiến, tham vấn. "Consult stakeholders" = tham vấn các bên liên quan; "consult a manual" = tra cứu sách hướng dẫn.
items.explanationEn: consult /kənˈsʌlt/ (verb): to ask someone for advice. "Consult stakeholders" means ask their views; "consult a manual" means look it up.

items.question: Trong câu "A party that only receives and never sends anything back is usually a sign you missed a flow — or that the party does not really belong in the context.", từ "belong" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A party that only receives and never sends anything back is usually a sign you missed a flow — or that the party does not really belong in the context.", what does "belong" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to be in the right place
items.explanation: belong /bɪˈlɒŋ/ (động từ): nên nằm trong, thuộc về. "Belong in X" = đúng chỗ ở trong X; "belong to someone" = thuộc sở hữu của ai.
items.explanationEn: belong /bɪˈlɒŋ/ (verb): to be in the right place. "Belong in X" means fit in X; "belong to someone" means be owned by them.

items.question: Trong câu "One distinction worth stating explicitly: the context model of an organization is not the context model of a system.", từ "distinction" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One distinction worth stating explicitly: the context model of an organization is not the context model of a system.", what does "distinction" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: distinction /dɪˈstɪŋk.ʃən/ (danh từ): sự phân biệt. "Draw a distinction between A and B" = phân biệt A và B; "with distinction" = loại xuất sắc.
items.explanationEn: distinction /dɪˈstɪŋk.ʃən/ (noun): a difference between similar things. "Draw a distinction between A and B"; "with distinction" means with honours.

items.question: Trong câu "For a system, the circle is the software and the outside may include internal departments too.", từ "internal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For a system, the circle is the software and the outside may include internal departments too.", what does "internal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: internal /ɪnˈtɜː.nəl/ (tính từ): nội bộ. Trái nghĩa: external; "internal departments" = các phòng ban trong công ty.
items.explanationEn: internal /ɪnˈtɜː.nəl/ (adjective): inside an organization. Opposite: external; "internal departments" are within the company.

items.question: Trong câu "Step inside the boundary.", từ "boundary" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Step inside the boundary.", what does "boundary" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: boundary /ˈbaʊn.dər.i/ (danh từ): ranh giới. "System boundary" = ranh giới hệ thống, tách phần trong phạm vi với bên ngoài.
items.explanationEn: boundary /ˈbaʊn.dər.i/ (noun): a line marking a limit. "System boundary" separates what is in scope from the outside.

items.question: Trong câu "A functional flow diagram shows the functions (departments, roles) and the information flowing between them — but says nothing about time order yet.", từ "function" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A functional flow diagram shows the functions (departments, roles) and the information flowing between them — but says nothing about time order yet.", what does "function" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a department or role in a business
items.explanation: function /ˈfʌŋk.ʃən/ (danh từ): bộ phận chức năng. Ở đây function = phòng ban/vai trò; "cross-functional" = liên phòng ban.
items.explanationEn: function /ˈfʌŋk.ʃən/ (noun): a department or role in a business. Here a function is a department or role; "cross-functional" means across departments.

items.question: Trong câu "This diagram answers what the context model cannot: information enters the organization, and then whose hands does it pass through before it leaves again.", từ "pass through" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This diagram answers what the context model cannot: information enters the organization, and then whose hands does it pass through before it leaves again.", what does "pass through" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to go from one side to another via
items.explanation: pass through /ˌpɑːs ˈθruː/ (cụm từ): đi qua. "Pass through someone's hands" = đi qua tay ai xử lý.
items.explanationEn: pass through /ˌpɑːs ˈθruː/ (phrase): to go from one side to another via. "Pass through someone's hands" means being handled by them.

items.question: Trong câu "The biggest payoff of a functional flow diagram: it exposes "orphan" information.", từ "payoff" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The biggest payoff of a functional flow diagram: it exposes "orphan" information.", what does "payoff" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: payoff /ˈpeɪ.ɒf/ (danh từ): lợi ích thu được. "The payoff is…" = cái được nhận lại là…; động từ "pay off" = đem lại kết quả.
items.explanationEn: payoff /ˈpeɪ.ɒf/ (noun): a benefit gained from effort. "The payoff is…" names the reward; the verb "pay off" means to bring results.

items.question: Trong câu "The biggest payoff of a functional flow diagram: it exposes "orphan" information.", từ "orphan" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The biggest payoff of a functional flow diagram: it exposes "orphan" information.", what does "orphan" (adjective) mean?
options: bị bỏ rơi, không ai dùng
optionsEn: left with no owner or user
items.explanation: orphan /ˈɔː.fən/ (tính từ): bị bỏ rơi, không ai dùng. Nghĩa gốc: trẻ mồ côi; trong IT "orphan data/record" = dữ liệu không còn liên kết.
items.explanationEn: orphan /ˈɔː.fən/ (adjective): left with no owner or user. Literally a child with no parents; in IT "orphan records" have no owner or link.

items.question: Trong câu "either you are missing a flow, or that data is being collected and nobody needs it.", từ "collect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "either you are missing a flow, or that data is being collected and nobody needs it.", what does "collect" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to gather antiques as a hobby
items.explanation: collect /kəˈlekt/ (động từ): thu thập. "Collect data" = thu thập dữ liệu; danh từ: collection.
items.explanationEn: collect /kəˈlekt/ (verb): to gather together. "Collect data" is a common collocation; noun: collection.

items.question: Trong câu "This is the diagram most often used in BA documentation, also known as a swimlane diagram.", từ "also known as" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the diagram most often used in BA documentation, also known as a swimlane diagram.", what does "also known as" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: also known as /ˈɔːl.səʊ nəʊn æz/ (cụm từ): còn được gọi là. Viết tắt: a.k.a.; dùng để giới thiệu tên gọi khác.
items.explanationEn: also known as /ˈɔːl.səʊ nəʊn æz/ (phrase): also called. Abbreviated a.k.a.; it introduces another name.

items.question: Trong câu "The structure: one large box named for the process; inside it, horizontal or vertical lanes, one per role; steps sit in the lane of whoever performs them; arrows connect the steps in true time order.", từ "perform" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The structure: one large box named for the process; inside it, horizontal or vertical lanes, one per role; steps sit in the lane of whoever performs them; arrows connect the steps in true time order.", what does "perform" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: perform /pəˈfɔːm/ (động từ): thực hiện. "Perform a task/step" = thực hiện nhiệm vụ; danh từ: performance (cũng là hiệu năng).
items.explanationEn: perform /pəˈfɔːm/ (verb): to carry out a task. "Perform a task" means do it; noun: performance.

items.question: Trong câu "The structure: one large box named for the process; inside it, horizontal or vertical lanes, one per role; steps sit in the lane of whoever performs them; arrows connect the steps in true time order.", từ "vertical" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The structure: one large box named for the process; inside it, horizontal or vertical lanes, one per role; steps sit in the lane of whoever performs them; arrows connect the steps in true time order.", what does "vertical" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: vertical /ˈvɜː.tɪ.kəl/ (tính từ): theo chiều dọc. Trái nghĩa: horizontal; trong kinh doanh "vertical" còn là ngành dọc (một thị trường cụ thể).
items.explanationEn: vertical /ˈvɜː.tɪ.kəl/ (adjective): going straight up and down. Opposite: horizontal; in business a "vertical" is a specific industry market.

items.question: Trong câu "With horizontal lanes, time runs left to right; an arrow going back should only ever be a deliberate loop.", từ "horizontal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With horizontal lanes, time runs left to right; an arrow going back should only ever be a deliberate loop.", what does "horizontal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: horizontal /ˌhɒr.ɪˈzɒn.təl/ (tính từ): theo chiều ngang. "Horizontal lanes" = các làn nằm ngang; "horizontal scaling" = mở rộng theo chiều ngang.
items.explanationEn: horizontal /ˌhɒr.ɪˈzɒn.təl/ (adjective): going from side to side. "Horizontal lanes" run left to right; "horizontal scaling" adds more machines.

items.question: Trong câu "With horizontal lanes, time runs left to right; an arrow going back should only ever be a deliberate loop.", từ "deliberate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "With horizontal lanes, time runs left to right; an arrow going back should only ever be a deliberate loop.", what does "deliberate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: deliberate /dɪˈlɪb.ər.ət/ (tính từ): có chủ ý. Phát âm động từ "deliberate" /dɪˈlɪb.ə.reɪt/ = cân nhắc kỹ, khác với tính từ.
items.explanationEn: deliberate /dɪˈlɪb.ər.ət/ (adjective): done on purpose. The verb "deliberate" /dɪˈlɪb.ə.reɪt/ means to think carefully, unlike the adjective.

items.question: Trong câu "The most informative thing on this diagram is not the steps — it is every time an arrow crosses a lane.", từ "informative" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most informative thing on this diagram is not the steps — it is every time an arrow crosses a lane.", what does "informative" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: informative /ɪnˈfɔː.mə.tɪv/ (tính từ): nhiều thông tin hữu ích. "An informative report" = báo cáo có nhiều thông tin giá trị.
items.explanationEn: informative /ɪnˈfɔː.mə.tɪv/ (adjective): giving useful information. "An informative report" gives valuable information.

items.question: Trong câu "There the process waits on someone else, information has to be passed across in full, and responsibility changes owner.", từ "in full" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "There the process waits on someone else, information has to be passed across in full, and responsibility changes owner.", what does "in full" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in full /ɪn ˈfʊl/ (cụm từ): đầy đủ, trọn vẹn. "Pay in full" = trả đủ; "read the terms in full" = đọc toàn bộ điều khoản.
items.explanationEn: in full /ɪn ˈfʊl/ (phrase): completely, with nothing missing. "Pay in full" means pay all; "read in full" means read everything.

items.question: Trong câu "There the process waits on someone else, information has to be passed across in full, and responsibility changes owner.", từ "responsibility" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "There the process waits on someone else, information has to be passed across in full, and responsibility changes owner.", what does "responsibility" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a duty to deal with something
items.explanation: responsibility /rɪˌspɒn.səˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): trách nhiệm. "Take responsibility for X" = chịu trách nhiệm về X.
items.explanationEn: responsibility /rɪˌspɒn.səˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): a duty to deal with something. "Take responsibility for X" means accept the duty for X.

items.question: Trong câu "A step straddling two lanes means you have not decided who owns it — decide, or split it into two steps.", từ "straddle" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A step straddling two lanes means you have not decided who owns it — decide, or split it into two steps.", what does "straddle" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: straddle /ˈstræd.əl/ (động từ): nằm vắt ngang. Nghĩa gốc: ngồi dạng chân hai bên; nghĩa bóng: nằm giữa hai bên.
items.explanationEn: straddle /ˈstræd.əl/ (verb): to extend across two areas. Literally to sit with a leg on each side; figuratively to span two areas.

items.question: Trong câu "A step straddling two lanes means you have not decided who owns it — decide, or split it into two steps.", từ "split" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A step straddling two lanes means you have not decided who owns it — decide, or split it into two steps.", what does "split" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: split /splɪt/ (động từ): tách ra. "Split X into Y" = tách X thành Y; quá khứ vẫn là split.
items.explanationEn: split /splɪt/ (verb): to divide into parts. "Split X into Y" means divide X into Y; the past form is also split.

items.question: Trong câu "Three to five lanes is the workable range.", từ "workable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three to five lanes is the workable range.", what does "workable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: workable /ˈwɜː.kə.bəl/ (tính từ): khả thi, dùng được. "A workable solution" = giải pháp khả thi trong thực tế.
items.explanationEn: workable /ˈwɜː.kə.bəl/ (adjective): practical and able to work. "A workable solution" is one that works in practice.

items.question: Trong câu "Many more means you are merging several processes into one diagram.", từ "merge" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many more means you are merging several processes into one diagram.", what does "merge" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: merge /mɜːdʒ/ (động từ): gộp lại. "Merge A and B" = gộp A và B; "merger" = sáp nhập công ty.
items.explanationEn: merge /mɜːdʒ/ (verb): to combine into one. "Merge A and B" combines them; a "merger" joins two companies.

items.question: Trong câu "When you need the full operational detail of one process, use a process flowchart.", từ "operational" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "When you need the full operational detail of one process, use a process flowchart.", what does "operational" (adjective) mean?
optionsEn: relating to how work runs daily
items.explanation: operational /ˌɒp.ərˈeɪ.ʃən.əl/ (tính từ): thuộc về vận hành. "Operational level" = cấp vận hành hằng ngày, đối lập với "strategic level".
items.explanationEn: operational /ˌɒp.ərˈeɪ.ʃən.əl/ (adjective): relating to how work runs daily. "Operational level" is day-to-day work, as opposed to "strategic level".

items.question: Trong câu "It is the only one of the four that forces you to cover every possible outcome of every decision.", từ "outcome" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is the only one of the four that forces you to cover every possible outcome of every decision.", what does "outcome" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: outcome /ˈaʊt.kʌm/ (danh từ): kết quả. "Possible outcome" = kết quả có thể xảy ra; mỗi quyết định có nhiều outcome.
items.explanationEn: outcome /ˈaʊt.kʌm/ (noun): the result of an action. "Possible outcome" is a result that could happen; each decision has several.

items.question: Trong câu "It is the only one of the four that forces you to cover every possible outcome of every decision.", từ "force" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is the only one of the four that forces you to cover every possible outcome of every decision.", what does "force" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: force /fɔːs/ (động từ): buộc, bắt phải. "Force someone to do X" = buộc ai làm X; danh từ "force" = lực, sức mạnh.
items.explanationEn: force /fɔːs/ (verb): to make someone do something. "Force someone to do X"; as a noun "force" means power or strength.

items.question: Trong câu "Three symbols cover most cases:", từ "cover" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three symbols cover most cases:", what does "cover" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: cover /ˈkʌv.ər/ (động từ): bao quát, áp dụng cho. "Cover most cases" = bao quát phần lớn trường hợp; "cover a story" = đưa tin.
items.explanationEn: cover /ˈkʌv.ər/ (verb): to include or deal with. "Cover most cases" means handle most situations; "cover a story" means report it.

items.question: Trong câu "The example — how a consulting firm takes in a request:", từ "take in" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The example — how a consulting firm takes in a request:", what does "take in" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: take in /ˌteɪk ˈɪn/ (cụm từ): tiếp nhận. "Take in a request/client" = tiếp nhận yêu cầu/khách; "be taken in" = bị lừa.
items.explanationEn: take in /ˌteɪk ˈɪn/ (phrase): to receive and accept. "Take in a request" means receive it; "be taken in" means be fooled.

items.question: Trong câu "The example — how a consulting firm takes in a request:", từ "firm" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The example — how a consulting firm takes in a request:", what does "firm" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: firm /fɜːm/ (danh từ): công ty. Là tính từ "firm" = chắc chắn; "consulting/law firm" = công ty tư vấn/luật.
items.explanationEn: firm /fɜːm/ (noun): a business company. As an adjective "firm" means solid; "consulting/law firm" is a company.

items.question: Trong câu "The loop has a way out.", từ "way out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The loop has a way out.", what does "way out" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: way out /ˌweɪ ˈaʊt/ (cụm từ): lối thoát. "Way out" = lối ra; "a way out of a problem" = cách thoát khỏi vấn đề.
items.explanationEn: way out /ˌweɪ ˈaʊt/ (phrase): an exit or escape. "Way out" is an exit; "a way out of a problem" is a solution.

items.question: Trong câu "A loop that returns to the same point without changing anything is an infinite loop.", từ "infinite" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A loop that returns to the same point without changing anything is an infinite loop.", what does "infinite" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: infinite /ˈɪn.fɪ.nət/ (tính từ): vô hạn. "Infinite loop" = vòng lặp vô hạn; trái nghĩa: finite.
items.explanationEn: infinite /ˈɪn.fɪ.nət/ (adjective): without an end or limit. "Infinite loop" never ends; opposite: finite.

items.question: Trong câu "The "No" branches are not abandoned.", từ "abandon" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The "No" branches are not abandoned.", what does "abandon" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: abandon /əˈbæn.dən/ (động từ): bỏ mặc, bỏ dở. "Abandoned cart" = giỏ hàng bị bỏ dở; danh từ: abandonment.
items.explanationEn: abandon /əˈbæn.dən/ (verb): to leave without care. "Abandoned cart" is a left shopping cart; noun: abandonment.

items.question: Trong câu "Both price questions have an explicit path for a "no": one leads to recalculating the cost, the other leads to an ending.", từ "explicit" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Both price questions have an explicit path for a "no": one leads to recalculating the cost, the other leads to an ending.", what does "explicit" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: explicit /ɪkˈsplɪs.ɪt/ (tính từ): rõ ràng, tường minh. Trái nghĩa: implicit; "explicit content" còn có nghĩa nội dung nhạy cảm.
items.explanationEn: explicit /ɪkˈsplɪs.ɪt/ (adjective): clearly stated. Opposite: implicit; "explicit content" can also mean adult content.

items.question: Trong câu "Both price questions have an explicit path for a "no": one leads to recalculating the cost, the other leads to an ending.", từ "recalculate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Both price questions have an explicit path for a "no": one leads to recalculating the cost, the other leads to an ending.", what does "recalculate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: recalculate /ˌriːˈkæl.kjə.leɪt/ (động từ): tính toán lại. Tiền tố "re-" = làm lại: recalculate, reconfirm, redo.
items.explanationEn: recalculate /ˌriːˈkæl.kjə.leɪt/ (verb): to calculate again. The prefix "re-" means again: recalculate, reconfirm, redo.

items.question: Trong câu "Two different end points, on purpose.", từ "on purpose" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Two different end points, on purpose.", what does "on purpose" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: on purpose /ɒn ˈpɜː.pəs/ (cụm từ): cố ý. Đồng nghĩa: deliberately, intentionally; trái nghĩa: by accident.
items.explanationEn: on purpose /ɒn ˈpɜː.pəs/ (phrase): intentionally. Synonyms: deliberately, intentionally; opposite: by accident.

items.question: Trong câu "erases the most important thing the process tells you.", từ "erase" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "erases the most important thing the process tells you.", what does "erase" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: erase /ɪˈreɪz/ (động từ): xóa mất. "Erase data" = xóa dữ liệu; ở đây nghĩa bóng: làm mất thông tin quan trọng.
items.explanationEn: erase /ɪˈreɪz/ (verb): to remove completely. "Erase data" deletes it; here it means losing key meaning.

items.question: Trong câu "How to check a flowchart: walk every branch until it reaches a terminator.", từ "terminator" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "How to check a flowchart: walk every branch until it reaches a terminator.", what does "terminator" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: terminator /ˈtɜː.mɪ.neɪ.tər/ (danh từ): điểm đầu/cuối (sơ đồ). Động từ gốc: terminate (kết thúc); hình bầu dục trong flowchart là terminator.
items.explanationEn: terminator /ˈtɜː.mɪ.neɪ.tər/ (noun): a start or end symbol. From "terminate" (end); the rounded shape in a flowchart is the terminator.

items.question: Trong câu "If any branch dead-ends, or any diamond has only one way out, the diagram is not finished.", từ "dead-end" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If any branch dead-ends, or any diamond has only one way out, the diagram is not finished.", what does "dead-end" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to stop with no way forward
items.explanation: dead-end /ˌdedˈend/ (động từ): đi vào ngõ cụt. Danh từ "a dead end" = ngõ cụt; "a dead-end job" = công việc không có tương lai.
items.explanationEn: dead-end /ˌdedˈend/ (verb): to stop with no way forward. Noun "a dead end" is a blocked road; "a dead-end job" has no future.

items.question: Trong câu "If any branch dead-ends, or any diamond has only one way out, the diagram is not finished.", từ "diamond" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If any branch dead-ends, or any diamond has only one way out, the diagram is not finished.", what does "diamond" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: diamond /ˈdaɪə.mənd/ (danh từ): hình thoi. Trong flowchart, hình thoi (diamond) là điểm quyết định; nghĩa gốc là kim cương.
items.explanationEn: diamond /ˈdaɪə.mənd/ (noun): a four-sided shape with points. In a flowchart the diamond is a decision; literally a precious stone.

items.question: Trong câu "Model precisely, across many parties, and possibly execute it", từ "precisely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Model precisely, across many parties, and possibly execute it", what does "precisely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: precisely /prɪˈsaɪs.li/ (trạng từ): một cách chính xác. Tính từ: precise; danh từ: precision.
items.explanationEn: precisely /prɪˈsaɪs.li/ (adverb): exactly and accurately. Adjective: precise; noun: precision.

items.question: Trong câu "Model precisely, across many parties, and possibly execute it", từ "execute" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Model precisely, across many parties, and possibly execute it", what does "execute" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: execute /ˈek.sɪ.kjuːt/ (động từ): thực thi, chạy. BPMN có thể được "execute" bằng engine quy trình; danh từ: execution.
items.explanationEn: execute /ˈek.sɪ.kjuːt/ (verb): to run or carry out. BPMN models can be executed by a process engine; noun: execution.

items.question: Trong câu "BPMN does not replace the four diagrams above — it is a standardized upgrade of the cross-functional flow diagram, plus events, messages, subprocesses, and error handling.", từ "standardized" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BPMN does not replace the four diagrams above — it is a standardized upgrade of the cross-functional flow diagram, plus events, messages, subprocesses, and error handling.", what does "standardized" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: standardized /ˈstæn.də.daɪzd/ (tính từ): được chuẩn hóa. Cách viết Anh: standardised; "standardized test" = bài kiểm tra chuẩn hóa.
items.explanationEn: standardized /ˈstæn.də.daɪzd/ (adjective): made to follow a standard. British spelling: standardised; a "standardized test" follows fixed rules.

items.question: Trong câu "BPMN does not replace the four diagrams above — it is a standardized upgrade of the cross-functional flow diagram, plus events, messages, subprocesses, and error handling.", từ "upgrade" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BPMN does not replace the four diagrams above — it is a standardized upgrade of the cross-functional flow diagram, plus events, messages, subprocesses, and error handling.", what does "upgrade" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: upgrade /ˈʌp.ɡreɪd/ (danh từ): bản nâng cấp. Động từ cùng dạng: "upgrade to X" = nâng cấp lên X.
items.explanationEn: upgrade /ˈʌp.ɡreɪd/ (noun): an improved version. Also a verb: "upgrade to X".

items.question: Trong câu "Must use a dashed message flow", từ "dashed" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Must use a dashed message flow", what does "dashed" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: dashed /dæʃt/ (tính từ): nét đứt. Trong BPMN, message flow là mũi tên nét đứt; "dotted" = nét chấm.
items.explanationEn: dashed /dæʃt/ (adjective): drawn as a broken line. In BPMN a message flow is dashed; "dotted" means made of dots.

items.question: Trong câu "Many BAs burn time arguing which notation is better, when the answer depends on who is going to read the drawing.", từ "notation" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many BAs burn time arguing which notation is better, when the answer depends on who is going to read the drawing.", what does "notation" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: notation /nəʊˈteɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): hệ ký hiệu. BPMN và UML là các "modeling notations" (hệ ký hiệu mô hình hóa).
items.explanationEn: notation /nəʊˈteɪ.ʃən/ (noun): a system of symbols. BPMN and UML are "modeling notations".

items.question: Trong câu "Many BAs burn time arguing which notation is better, when the answer depends on who is going to read the drawing.", từ "burn time" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many BAs burn time arguing which notation is better, when the answer depends on who is going to read the drawing.", what does "burn time" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: burn time /ˌbɜːn ˈtaɪm/ (cụm từ): phí thời gian. Khẩu ngữ công sở; tương tự "waste time"; "burn money" = đốt tiền.
items.explanationEn: burn time /ˌbɜːn ˈtaɪm/ (phrase): to waste time. Informal workplace English, like "waste time"; "burn money" is similar.

items.question: Trong câu "It is the cheapest diagram to draw and the one that most often prevents the most expensive mistake — discovering late that a participant was never in scope.", từ "prevent" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is the cheapest diagram to draw and the one that most often prevents the most expensive mistake — discovering late that a participant was never in scope.", what does "prevent" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: prevent /prɪˈvent/ (động từ): ngăn chặn. "Prevent X from happening" = ngăn X xảy ra; danh từ: prevention.
items.explanationEn: prevent /prɪˈvent/ (verb): to stop something happening. "Prevent X from happening"; noun: prevention.

items.question: Trong câu "It is the cheapest diagram to draw and the one that most often prevents the most expensive mistake — discovering late that a participant was never in scope.", từ "in scope" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It is the cheapest diagram to draw and the one that most often prevents the most expensive mistake — discovering late that a participant was never in scope.", what does "in scope" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in scope /ɪn ˈskəʊp/ (cụm từ): trong phạm vi dự án. Trái nghĩa: out of scope; dùng rất nhiều khi chốt yêu cầu.
items.explanationEn: in scope /ɪn ˈskəʊp/ (phrase): included in the project. Opposite: out of scope; used constantly when agreeing requirements.

items.question: Trong câu "The process hangs in real life, not just on paper", từ "on paper" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The process hangs in real life, not just on paper", what does "on paper" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: on paper /ɒn ˈpeɪ.pər/ (cụm từ): trên giấy tờ, lý thuyết. "It looks good on paper" = trông ổn trên lý thuyết (nhưng thực tế có thể không).
items.explanationEn: on paper /ɒn ˈpeɪ.pər/ (phrase): in theory, not in reality. "It looks good on paper" means it seems fine in theory.

items.question: Trong câu "You lose the baseline for proving improvement, and the people who run the process will not recognize it", từ "baseline" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You lose the baseline for proving improvement, and the people who run the process will not recognize it", what does "baseline" (noun) mean?
options: mốc cơ sở để so sánh
items.explanation: baseline /ˈbeɪs.laɪn/ (danh từ): mốc cơ sở để so sánh. "Establish a baseline" = xác lập mốc hiện trạng để đo cải tiến.
items.explanationEn: baseline /ˈbeɪs.laɪn/ (noun): a starting point for comparison. "Establish a baseline" means record the starting state to measure change.

items.question: Trong câu "As-is is reality, even when reality is messy", từ "messy" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "As-is is reality, even when reality is messy", what does "messy" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: messy /ˈmes.i/ (tính từ): lộn xộn, rối rắm. Danh từ: mess; "a messy process" = quy trình rối rắm.
items.explanationEn: messy /ˈmes.i/ (adjective): untidy and complicated. Noun: mess; "a messy process" is disorganised.

items.question: Trong câu "One very effective check: hand the diagram to someone who was not in the meeting and ask them to narrate the process back.", từ "narrate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One very effective check: hand the diagram to someone who was not in the meeting and ask them to narrate the process back.", what does "narrate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: narrate /nəˈreɪt/ (động từ): kể lại, thuật lại. "Narrate back" = kể lại theo cách hiểu của mình; danh từ: narrative, narrator.
items.explanationEn: narrate /nəˈreɪt/ (verb): to describe events in order. "Narrate back" means retell in your own words; nouns: narrative, narrator.

items.question: Trong câu "Wherever they hesitate is where the diagram is unclear — and that is usually exactly where the delivery team will misread it.", từ "hesitate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Wherever they hesitate is where the diagram is unclear — and that is usually exactly where the delivery team will misread it.", what does "hesitate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: hesitate /ˈhez.ɪ.teɪt/ (động từ): ngập ngừng, do dự. "Don't hesitate to contact us" = cứ liên hệ, đừng ngại — câu hay gặp trong email.
items.explanationEn: hesitate /ˈhez.ɪ.teɪt/ (verb): to pause before acting. "Don't hesitate to contact us" is a common email phrase.

items.question: Trong câu "Wherever they hesitate is where the diagram is unclear — and that is usually exactly where the delivery team will misread it.", từ "misread" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Wherever they hesitate is where the diagram is unclear — and that is usually exactly where the delivery team will misread it.", what does "misread" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: misread /ˌmɪsˈriːd/ (động từ): đọc hiểu sai. Tiền tố "mis-" = sai: misread, misunderstand, misuse.
items.explanationEn: misread /ˌmɪsˈriːd/ (verb): to understand wrongly. The prefix "mis-" means wrongly: misread, misunderstand, misuse.

items.question: Trong câu "A functional flow diagram shows which department exchanges what information, deliberately omitting sequence so the meeting stays on "who needs to know what".", từ "omit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A functional flow diagram shows which department exchanges what information, deliberately omitting sequence so the meeting stays on "who needs to know what".", what does "omit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: omit /əˈmɪt/ (động từ): lược bỏ. Danh từ: omission (sự bỏ sót); đồng nghĩa khẩu ngữ: leave out.
items.explanationEn: omit /əˈmɪt/ (verb): to leave out. Noun: omission; informal synonym: leave out.

items.question: Trong câu "The most informative thing on a swimlane is every lane crossing — each handoff is a point of waiting, information loss, and changed ownership.", từ "ownership" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The most informative thing on a swimlane is every lane crossing — each handoff is a point of waiting, information loss, and changed ownership.", what does "ownership" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: ownership /ˈəʊ.nə.ʃɪp/ (danh từ): quyền phụ trách. "Take ownership of a task" = chủ động nhận trách nhiệm về việc đó.
items.explanationEn: ownership /ˈəʊ.nə.ʃɪp/ (noun): responsibility for something. "Take ownership of a task" means accept responsibility for it.

items.question: Trong câu "Several different end points are legitimate and often necessary — "ended with no work" is not the same as "ended with work".", từ "legitimate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Several different end points are legitimate and often necessary — "ended with no work" is not the same as "ended with work".", what does "legitimate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: legitimate /lɪˈdʒɪt.ə.mət/ (tính từ): hợp lệ, chính đáng. "A legitimate reason" = lý do chính đáng; trái nghĩa: illegitimate.
items.explanationEn: legitimate /lɪˈdʒɪt.ə.mət/ (adjective): valid and acceptable. "A legitimate reason" is a valid one; opposite: illegitimate.

items.question: Trong câu "BPMN is the next step, not a replacement — reach for it when the reader needs precision, and keep the diagram simple when the reader needs to understand it fast.", từ "reach for" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BPMN is the next step, not a replacement — reach for it when the reader needs precision, and keep the diagram simple when the reader needs to understand it fast.", what does "reach for" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to stretch out a hand for
items.explanation: reach for /ˈriːtʃ fɔːr/ (cụm từ): chọn dùng đến. Nghĩa gốc: với tay lấy; nghĩa bóng: chọn dùng công cụ nào khi cần.
items.explanationEn: reach for /ˈriːtʃ fɔːr/ (phrase): to choose to use. Literally stretch a hand toward; figuratively choose a tool when needed.

items.question: Trong câu "BPMN is the next step, not a replacement — reach for it when the reader needs precision, and keep the diagram simple when the reader needs to understand it fast.", từ "precision" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "BPMN is the next step, not a replacement — reach for it when the reader needs precision, and keep the diagram simple when the reader needs to understand it fast.", what does "precision" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: precision /prɪˈsɪʒ.ən/ (danh từ): độ chính xác. Tính từ: precise; "high precision" = độ chính xác cao.
items.explanationEn: precision /prɪˈsɪʒ.ən/ (noun): exactness. Adjective: precise; "high precision" means very exact.
